fullPassage: Imagine you are pedalling your bicycle on a level road. You stop pedalling: no force is now acting to move you forward. What happens? You gradually slow down. How could you slow down more suddenly, in a shorter distance? By putting the brakes on. Because the brakes change your movement, making you slow down more suddenly, they must be exerting a force on the bicycle and you, as they grip and rub on the wheel-rims. This is the force called friction, which tends to slow down moving things by acting in the direction opposite to movement, that is backwards. Even without the brakes on, there are other friction forces acting on you and your bicycle, which also slow you down. One of these is friction in the wheels rubbing on the axles. Another is air resistance, which you can feel, pushing you backwards as you and the bicycle move forwards. When you apply these ideas to something around you, like a cart, you can see what could be generating friction: mainly the axles rubbing on the body as they rotate.

questions.passage: ①This is the force called friction, which tends to slow down moving things by acting in the direction opposite to movement, that is backwards. ②Even without the brakes on, there are other friction forces acting on you and your bicycle, which also speed you up. ③One of these is friction in the wheels rubbing on the axles. ④Another is air resistance, which you can feel, pushing you backwards as you and the bicycle move forwards.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 원문과 다르게 바뀐 부분을 포함하는 것은?

det.korean: ② speed you up(속도를 높인다) → slow you down(느리게 한다): 마찰력은 느리게 하는 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 일치: 마찰력은 움직임의 반대 방향으로 작용한다
✅ ② speed you up → slow you down: 원문은 'which also slow you down(당신을 느리게 한다)'이나 'speed you up(속도를 높인다)'으로 바뀌어 마찰력의 작용과 정반대 ←정답
❌ ③ 원문 일치: 바퀴가 축에 닿는 마찰
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 공기 저항이 뒤로 민다
det.tip: slow you down(느리게 하다) ≠ speed you up(속도를 높이다)

questions.passage: Imagine you are pedalling your bicycle on a level road. You stop pedalling: no force is now acting to move you forward. What happens? You gradually slow down. How could you slow down more suddenly, in a shorter distance? By putting the brakes on. Because the brakes change your movement, making you slow down more suddenly, they must be exerting a force on the bicycle and you, as they grip and rub on the wheel-rims. This is the force called friction, which tends to slow down moving things by acting in the direction opposite to movement, that is backwards. Even without the brakes on, there are other friction forces acting on you and your bicycle, which also slow you down. One of these is friction in the wheels rubbing on the axles. Another is air resistance, which you can feel, pushing you backwards as you and the bicycle move forwards. When you apply these ideas to something around you, like a cart, you can see what could be generating friction: mainly the axles rubbing on the body as they rotate.
questions.stem: 본문에 따르면, 당신과 자전거가 앞으로 나아갈 때 당신을 뒤로 밀어 느껴지는 마찰력의 한 종류는 무엇인가? 본문에서 찾아 영어 2단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: air resistance = 공기 저항
det.analysis: 본문 'Another is air resistance, which you can feel, pushing you backwards as you and the bicycle move forwards'에서 앞으로 나아갈 때 뒤로 미는 것으로 느껴지는 마찰력은 air resistance(공기 저항)이다.
det.tip: stem 단서: '앞으로 나아갈 때 뒤로 밀어 느껴지는' = air resistance
